description: A user's shelf. The four reading-status shelves use the fixed rkeys 'reading', 'read', 'to-read' and 'dnf'; any other rkey is a custom shelf the reader named. Written by the OAuth client (livtet-service).

name.description: Human-readable shelf name, the title of the shelf (e.g. 'Currently Reading').

description.description: Optional description of what the shelf collects. Custom shelves only; the reading-status shelves carry none.
